summary: The change does what was asked. verifier.md now tells the verifier to cite the recorded fmt, clippy and test results in the criterion's commands list, exactly as shown under "Checks Athena ran on this tree". It also says evidence text alone is not enough, because D43 reads only the commands list. I also ran the athena-cap-change tests, and they passed. The changelog says so, and the request's own budget requirement makes the trim reasonable. That leaves only 2 tokens of room.
